'''Thedavio VII''' was a world located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], a fleet of unidentified black [[Starship/Legends|starships]] was spotted near the planet. It was unknown whether they were some kind of new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] design.<ref name="HAT">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>
